Placement volatility events by fiscal year

Source: R/cxvol.R
cxyoy.Rd

The year-over-year table of placement volatility (Ruhela 2026, Appendix E, Table E15) from the person-year table: for each fiscal year the regional changes (vm summed), placements, person-years, the rates of changes per 1,000 placements and per 1,000 person-years with exact Poisson intervals, each year's share of all changes, and the percent changes from the previous year of the count and of both rates. The rate intervals are qgamma(a/2, n) to qgamma(1 - a/2, n + 1) over the exposure, so a count of 0 has lower limit 0.

Usage

cxyoy(x, level = 0.95, ...)

Arguments

x

A person-year table from otpyr(), or what otpyr() takes (a data frame of the release or a table key).

level

The confidence level of the gamma intervals of both rates: one number strictly between 0 and 1.

...

Passed to otpyr() when x is not a person-year table.

Value

A data frame of class cxyoy, one row per fiscal year: year, vm, np, py, rnp, rnplo, rnphi (per 1,000 placements), rpy, rpylo, rpyhi (per 1,000 person-years), share, dvm, drnp, drpy (percent changes from the previous year).

Details

The two rates can disagree in direction: placements per person-year move too, and the placement denominator absorbs their growth.

References

Ruhela, V. S. (2026). Alert complexity and placement volatility in Ontario restrictive confinement data. Major research paper, Centre for Criminology and Sociolegal Studies, University of Toronto.

Examples

p <- data.frame(year = rep(2024:2026, c(50, 60, 70)), vm = rpois(180, 0.2),
                np = rpois(180, 20) + 1)
cxyoy(p)
#> cxyoy: regional changes per fiscal year
#>  year vm   np py   rnp rnplo rnphi   rpy rpylo rpyhi  share     dvm   drnp
#>  2024 16 1064 50 15.04 8.595 24.42 320.0 182.9 519.7 0.3556      NA     NA
#>  2025 14 1218 60 11.49 6.284 19.29 233.3 127.6 391.5 0.3111 -12.500 -23.56
#>  2026 15 1493 70 10.05 5.623 16.57 214.3 119.9 353.4 0.3333   7.143 -12.59
#>     drpy
#>       NA
#>  -27.083
#>   -8.163
